qotom.type: ProcessKind x Faculty x Faculty x Faculty x Faculty -> Proposition
qotom.meaning: Each listed faculty is necessary for that process in its participating organ; no sufficiency or activity is asserted.

new_grammar: Fixed postfix dependency clause: P F1 F2 F3 F4 qotom = REQUIRES_EACH(P,{F1,F2,F3,F4}).
No permutation of written roles, implicit extra faculty or conclusion of successful nourishment.

seed_derivations.surface: ytchedy qodar qotedar qokar qotchd qotom
seed_derivations.denotation: NOURISHMENT implies possession of EACH of ATTRACT, RETAIN, ALTER, EXPEL in the relevant organ.

design.two_input_consequence: If nourishment holds but retention is absent the assertion fails; if nourishment holds but alteration is absent it also fails. Conversely all four faculties present without current nourishment is allowed.
design.serious_rival: The same list is an ordered sufficient recipe: executing all four guarantees nourishment. This adds event order and the converse implication.
design.falsifier: Fail the necessity reading if whole E asserts actual nourishment solely from possessing the list, or any repeated form must denote an action token rather than the fixed faculty. Do not rescue with a hidden biconditional.
design.hard_countercase: All six forms are individually rare in the block; this is weaker lexical reuse than cards18/19/21. IT qtchedy and RF qo@152;ar remain unassigned. The clause alone provides no subject-organ noun.
design.freedom: 6 whole-form meanings,1 postfix arity-five relation; future organ/reference binder must be explicit and counted.
